head_commit.message:
Gate proof runs on the best Lean Verified row, not the top row overall

Nil ruling 2026-10-20: verify a submission whose bound matches or beats the
best Lean Verified row of its board. A Claimed or Human Verified row, even a
better one, no longer blocks a proof run. current_record() keeps only rows with
site_tier verified, rerun_status passed and a receipt_path (the candidate
itself and reproductions stay out); with no such row the classical baseline is
the gate, and with neither selection stops. The selection check and the check
before compilation both use it, for issues and pull requests. The tie rule is
unchanged: a tie with a Lean Verified leader starts no run.

README, AGENTS.md and the submission docs state the rule. Tests: a better
Claimed row does not block, a tie with the Lean Verified leader does, a row
with site_tier verified but no receipt is not a leader, and a board without
Lean Verified rows gates on the baseline or refuses.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
